results.title: AWA debunks reports of aircraft technical fault and passenger evacuation at Kumasi Airport
results.content: Africa World Airlines (AWA) has dismissed social media reports claiming that one of its aircraft developed a technical problem at Kumasi Airport, resulting in the evacuation of passengers, describing the claims as false.

results.content: President John Dramani Mahama has unveiled plans to invest more than $9 billion in sectors with high job creation potential between 2027 and 2030 as part of a new policy initiative dubbed the New Economy.

results.title: UK cannot ‘cherry pick’ EU single market deal, Barnier tells BBC

results.title: Pope in ‘pretty good health’ as he starts Latin America tour
results.content: Pope Leo XIV has told reporters travelling with him to Latin America he is "in pretty good health", in his first comments on his condition since having surgery for lung cancer.

results.title: Police arrest 57-year-old man over viral shoplifting videos

results.title: Paraguay’s president impeached and under house arrest after bank collapse

results.title: ‘Why bring the waste to us?’ – Annoh-Dompreh demands answers over Nsawam plan
results.content: The Minority Chief Whip and MP for Nsawam-Adoagyiri, Frank Annoh-Dompreh, has demanded an explanation for a reported government plan to move waste from Agbogbloshie to a facility in the Nsawam area.

results.title: Nana B urges Mahama to act on Obuasi SHS headmaster abuse allegations
results.content: The National Second Vice Chairman of the New Patriotic Party (NPP) has called on President John Dramani Mahama to intervene in the reported abuse involving the Headmaster of Obuasi Senior High School (SHS), warning against any attempt to shield the suspect because of his political affiliation.

results.title: Asiedu Nketiah elected inaugural chair of African Political Parties Initiative
results.content: The National Democratic Congress (NDC) Chairman, Johnson Asiedu Nketiah has been elected the inaugural Chair of the African Political Parties Initiative (APPI), placing him at the head of a new continental platform for political parties. He was nominated by an interim committee established by APPI and was unanimously approved by members of the Political Parties in Africa at the African Political Parties Summit 2026 in Addis Ababa, Ethiopia, on Saturday, November 7, where the initiative's inaugural leadership was constituted.

results.title: Hope is a commodity political parties must sell
results.content: Hope is one of the most important commodities political parties must sell. Not through slogans, campaign promises or carefully choreographed speeches, but through the visible possibility of a better future. People are more willing to endure hardship, make sacrifices and invest their energies when they believe their efforts will lead somewhere. They will support difficult reforms when they can see the destination. They will make extraordinary contributions when they believe success is attainable.

results.title: New Economy to push Ghana towards investment grade – Dr. Ato Forson
results.content: This is to lower the country’s borrowing costs and help Ghanaian businesses raise long-term financing, Finance Minister Dr. Cassiel Ato Forson has said.

results.title: Asiedu Nketiah urges African parties to look beyond elections, build institutions for 2040
results.content: National Democratic Congress (NDC) Chairman Johnson Asiedu Nketiah has called on African political parties to strengthen their institutional capacity and prepare leaders capable of addressing the continent’s long-term development challenges. He said political parties must look beyond winning elections and invest in the knowledge, expertise and structures needed to govern effectively. Mr Asiedu Nketiah made the call in an acceptance address after assuming office as inaugural Chair of the African Political Parties Initiative (APPI) at the African Political Parties Summit 2026 in Addis Ababa, Ethiopia, on Saturday, November 7.
